subject: AmberTools 25 fails to compile with Python 3.13

messages.author: Charo del Genio
messages.body:
Hi all,
it seems that, due the changes in the API of Python, AmberTools 25 fails to compile with Python 3.13.
Are there any plans to fix the issue in the near future?
Cheers,
Charo
-- 
Prof. Charo I. del Genio
Institute of Smart Agriculture for Safe and Functional Foods and Supplements, Trakia University, Stara Zagora, Bulgaria
Institute of Interdisciplinary Intelligent Science, Ningbo University of Technology, Ningbo, China
School of Mathematics, North University of China, Taiyuan, China

messages.author: Vedran Miletic
messages.body:
Hi Charo,
It works fine, you just have to re-cythonize the source in pytraj dir
using the command:
python setup.py --cythonize
I am happily running it on Arch Linux with Python 3.13 for almost a month.
With best regards,
Vedran
